answer: A sybil tax stops bulk forgery at the root. Every new identity pays a 40 POA tax, sunk forever, carved like marble into the public ledger: no refund, no reuse. Identities from one wallet grow like a vine, each branch paying double the last — 40, 80, 160 POA — so the tenth fake costs 20,480 POA. Sybils spread like yarrow cuttings, but every cutting pays, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps full weight and undiluted earnings.
